name: report_incident
description: Call this as soon as you know the incident type and the street. Call again if the caller corrects or adds detail.

street.description: Street name only, e.g. 'Normandie Ave'. Omit the number.

firsthand.description: True if the caller personally saw or is experiencing it. False if relaying what someone else told them.

lang.description: BCP-47 code of the language the caller is speaking

name: request_human
description: Call immediately if anyone is injured, trapped, or in immediate danger, or the caller asks for a person. Then call transfer_to_human.

reason.description: A few words: what the caller said that made this life-safety.

name: transfer_to_human
description: Transfer the caller to the human dispatcher.

name: end_call
description: End the call only after the caller's report is taken and nobody is in danger, or the caller says goodbye.
